planets.name: TOI-904 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-904 with a 84-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-904 c was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-904. Its orbit and size follow Harris et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
